name: Shadowpact Statue
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-09: The Power of Legends

defensiveAbilities.name: Construct Armor (Hardness 10)
defensiveAbilities.description: Like normal objects, a shadowpact statue has Hardness. This Hardness reduces any damage it takes by an amount equal to the Hardness. Once a shadowpact statue is reduced to less than half its Hit Points, or immediately upon being damaged by a critical hit, its construct armor breaks, removing the Hardness and reducing its Armor Class to 22.

offensiveAbilities.name: Brazier
offensiveAbilities.description: The statue carries a wide brazier full of hot coals. To make flaming coal Strikes or use Burn Alive, the statue must have the brazier held in one hand or otherwise within reach. Instead of targeting the statue with an attack, a creature can target the brazier directly. The brazier has the same AC and saves as the statue. Dealing 15 Cold Damage damage to the brazier or dousing it with at least 2 gallons of water extinguishes the coals. This prevents the statue from using Burn Alive and causes its ranged attacks to no longer deal fire damage.

offensiveAbilities.name: Burn Alive
offensiveAbilities.description: The statue grinds a creature it has Grabbed or Restrained into the red-hot coals of its brazier. The target takes 3d8 Fire Damage damage and 1d8 Persistent,fire Damage damage.

offensiveAbilities.name: Mythic Ferocity
offensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency once per day

Requirements The shadowpact statue is not Wounded 3

Trigger The shadowpact statue is reduced to 0 HP

Effect The shadowpact statue avoids being knocked out and remains at half its maximum HP, but its wounded value increases by 1.

offensiveAbilities.name: Grab
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead use Grab and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.
